selection.ownership: DailyBot, Inc., a Delaware corporation. Terms of Service name DailyBot, Inc.; SOC2 Type II services are hosted on AWS US. Founding team in Pereira, Colombia and a New York/Westwood NJ presence do not make this a mainland-China edition. Global API at api.dailybot.com.

research.searchCoverage: Official Dailybot API reference, Authentication (X-API-KEY), GET /v1/me/, GET /v1/organization/, GET /v1/users/, GET /v1/users/{uuid}/, DailyBot Inc Delaware identity, AWS US hosting, and dated incident search (Dailybot/DailyBot + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No current unresolved Dailybot platform compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

Official Dailybot REST API at https://api.dailybot.com/v1/ with X-API-KEY was confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is DailyBot, Inc. (Delaware). Native category is productivity (source Communication is not in Rust CATEGORIES). Content-Type application/json is sent on GET because official docs require it.
